`laserfont2.shx` and `laserfont3.shx` are from [artkis/laserfont-single-line-stencil](https://github.com/artkis/laserfont-single-line-stencil)
(`cad/`), Copyright (c) 2026 Artkis, licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`, no Reserved Font Names).
They are AutoCAD-compiled unifonts, unchanged. SHA-256:

- `laserfont2.shx`: `319551ac418382aef879cb5ce23a3d18bb45684629352267716b83c323c4d417`
- `laserfont3.shx`: `326a2258f914457dc58e575f4378d27b14c5206dfa9ff124cf6c440aeb80079a` (as in the upstream `cad/native-test-report-v3.json`)

They are test data for `crates/text/tests/laserfont_shx.rs` only.
